name: text/scramble-reveal
title: Scramble Reveal
title_vi: Chữ nhiễu rồi chốt dần từ trái sang
desc_vi: Dòng chữ bắt đầu là các ký tự nhiễu, rồi chốt từng ký tự từ trái sang phải; vào bằng một đường cong nhẹ rồi trôi rất khẽ.
params_vi: glyphs: bộ ký tự nhiễu · seed: hạt giống cố định · inDur: thời gian vào (1.65 s) · lockTail, firstLock: nhịp chốt · hold: thời gian giữ (1.35 s) · drift: biên độ trôi (0.55 % chiều cao) · exit: none | fade | up
notes: Only the motion is ported. NOT ported: the terminal frame (bordered shell with '>_' prefix), the monospace font, the accent colours and the font fitting (all belong to the film; the source's style=clean is what this effect does). The glyph pool, the LCG (seed 0x27c0ffee, glyph = state % 44, skip the glyph equal to the target), the 30 fps rows and the left-to-right lock frames (first lock frame 6, last = round(1.5 x 30) = 45) are the source's, computed at build time and written into the film as a literal table; the proxy tween reads row floor(progress x 30). Because the film font is proportional (the source's is monospace), the scrambled glyphs are an overlay left-aligned over an invisible copy of the real text: the locked prefix is exactly in its final place, only the unlocked tail changes width. The source centres a constant-width mono string, so there the whole string does not shift; here the left edge stays fixed instead. Intended for one-line text. Source envelope depends on the clip duration D (default 3 s); here hold is a param (default 1.35 s = 3 - 1.65) and the IN/OUT compression for D < 2.1 s is not ported. Arrival x/y are 4 % of the frame width and 2.4 % of the height (cqw/cqh -> px from ctx.W/H); drift -0.55 % of the height with 0.3 s of stillness at the end of the hold. Exit up: x +5 %, y -3.5 %, opacity 0 over 0.45 s (default none, as in the source).
